name: Fibrous Dysplasia
definition: Benign developmental fibro-osseous bone disorder caused by post-zygotic GNAS mutation, affecting one or multiple bones and sometimes associated with endocrine abnormalities.

core: Neurological exam when cranio-spinal involvement exists

investigations.principle: Radiographs/CT show characteristic ground-glass matrix; MRI is used selectively; endocrine evaluation is needed when syndromic disease is suspected.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, tumor or occult-injury assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific pathway.

amber: Surgery is individualized for fracture, deformity or functional compromise; biopsy is reserved for atypical lesions.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Asthi-vikriti phenotype may be documented only in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Benign developmental fibro-osseous bone disorder caused by post-zygotic GNAS mutation, affecting one or multiple bones and sometimes associated with endocrine abnormalities.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for rapidly progressive weakness, respiratory/swallowing compromise, major vascular symptoms, suspected malignancy/pathological fracture, severe systemic illness or other listed red flags.
